```{r include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
### OLD 

# join df_phase1 with all new p1_recruiters
p1_all <- df_phase1 %>%
  left_join(
    p1_recruiters_new,
    # join on every column EXCEPT for `Referral ID`
    by = str_subset(colnames(df_phase1), "Referral ID", negate = T),
    suffix = c("_og", "_new")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    `Referral ID` = case_when(
      p1_id %in% p1_recruiters_new$p1_id ~ `Referral ID_new` %>% as.character(),
      .default = `Referral ID_og`
    )
  ) %>%
  select(p1_id, `Record ID`, form, `Referral ID`, everything(), -c(`Referral ID_og`, `Referral ID_new`))
```

```{r include=FALSE}
# read in Phase 1 email list 
p1_emails <- read_excel("../data/phase1/Phase_I_Email_Clicks (1).xlsx")

# indicate which people are KNOWN to have come from emails
p1_all <- p1_all %>%
  mutate(
    `Where did you hear about this study from?` = case_when(
      (
        str_to_title(`First Name`) %in% str_to_title(p1_emails$`First Name`) &
          str_to_title(`Last Name`) %in% str_to_title(p1_emails$`Last Name`)
      ) |
        str_to_lower(Email) %in% str_to_lower(p1_emails$Email) ~ "Email",
      .default = `Where did you hear about this study from?`
    )
  )
```


```{r include=FALSE}

# function to contextualize any group of founders
contextualize_possible_founders <- function(df = p1_all) {
  expected_founders <- df %>%
    # filter for demographic inclusion criteria
    filter(
      `Do you live in the United States or Canada?` == "Yes",
      `Do you consent to filling out your information and being contacted by our research team?` == "I consent"
    ) %>%
    # retain those who completed form, OR completed all relevant columns
    filter((
      `Complete?_2` == "Complete" | (
        `First Name` != "" &
          `Last Name` != "" &
          `Do you have vitiligo?` != "" &
          (`Street Address` != "" |
             City != "") &
          # (State != "" | Province != "") &
          # State != "" &
          # TODO: Add province / Canada location stuff!!!
          (`Phone Number (no spaces or dashes):` != "" |
             Email != "")
      )
    ) & State != "") %>%
    mutate(age = year(last_updated_est) - `Birth year`) %>%
    rename(
      has_vit = `Do you have vitiligo?`,
      phone = `Phone Number (no spaces or dashes):`,
      can_recruit_vit = `Would you be willing and able to recruit your family members for this study?`,
      can_recruit_healthy = `Do you have an affected family member and if so, would you be willing to recruit them for this study?`,
      comf_sampling_self = `Are you comfortable collecting medical samples at home? For this study, we will ask you to collect samples of your skin, blood, and saliva using devices we will supply. Click the following links to read more about the devices that we use: Blood drawing device Skin tape Micro patches Saliva collection kit`,
      comf_sampling_fam = `Do you believe that your family members would also be comfortable collecting medical samples at home?`
    ) %>%
    select(
      `Survey Timestamp`,
      p1_id:`Referral ID`,
      `First Name`,
      `Last Name`,
      `Birth year`,
      age,
      Email,
      phone,
      `Street Address`,
      Apt,
      City,
      State,
      Province,
      has_vit,
      can_recruit_vit,
      str_subset(colnames(.), "How many .+ can you enroll\\?$"),
      can_recruit_healthy,
      str_subset(colnames(.), "How many .+ can you enroll\\?_2"),
      comf_sampling_self,
      comf_sampling_fam,
      -form
    )
  
  
  # col to determine why phase I pt may be ineligible
  expected_founders_context <- expected_founders %>%
    mutate(
      founder_eligibility = case_when(
        # has vit, unwilling to recruit
        has_vit == "Yes" &
          can_recruit_vit != "Yes" &
          `How many children can you enroll?` %in% c(0, "", NA) &
          `How many siblings can you enroll?` %in% c(0, "", NA) &
          `How many family members can you enroll?` %in% c(0, "", NA) &
          `How many parents can you enroll?` %in% c(0, "", NA) &
          `How many cousins can you enroll?` %in% c(0, "", NA) &
          `How many nieces and nephews can you enroll?` %in% c(0, "", NA) &
          `How many other people can you enroll?` %in% c(0, "", NA) ~ F,
        # healthy, unwilling to recruit
        has_vit == "No" &
          can_recruit_healthy != "Yes" &
          `How many children can you enroll?_2` %in% c(0, "", NA) &
          `How many siblings can you enroll?_2` %in% c(0, "", NA) &
          `How many parents can you enroll?_2` %in% c(0, "", NA) &
          `How many cousins can you enroll?_2` %in% c(0, "", NA) &
          `How many nieces and nephews can you enroll?_2` %in% c(0, "", NA) &
          `How many other people can you enroll?_2` %in% c(0, "", NA) ~ F,
        # either they or their fam not comf with self-sampling
        comf_sampling_self != "Yes" & comf_sampling_fam != "Yes" ~ F,
        # duplicate entry
        `Referral ID` %in% c("", NA) ~ F,
        .default = T
      ),
      eligibility_reason = case_when(
        has_vit == "Yes" &
          can_recruit_vit != "Yes" &
          `How many children can you enroll?` %in% c(0, "", NA) &
          `How many siblings can you enroll?` %in% c(0, "", NA) &
          `How many family members can you enroll?` %in% c(0, "", NA) &
          `How many parents can you enroll?` %in% c(0, "", NA) &
          `How many cousins can you enroll?` %in% c(0, "", NA) &
          `How many nieces and nephews can you enroll?` %in% c(0, "", NA) &
          `How many other people can you enroll?` %in% c(0, "", NA) ~ "unwilling to recruit",
        has_vit == "No" &
          can_recruit_healthy != "Yes" &
          `How many children can you enroll?_2` %in% c(0, "", NA) &
          `How many siblings can you enroll?_2` %in% c(0, "", NA) &
          `How many parents can you enroll?_2` %in% c(0, "", NA) &
          `How many cousins can you enroll?_2` %in% c(0, "", NA) &
          `How many nieces and nephews can you enroll?_2` %in% c(0, "", NA) &
          `How many other people can you enroll?_2` %in% c(0, "", NA) ~ "unwilling to recruit",
        comf_sampling_self != "Yes" &
          comf_sampling_fam != "Yes" ~ "uncomf. sampling",
        `Referral ID` %in% c("", NA) ~ "likely duplicate entry or exists in Phase II",
        .default = NA
      )
    ) %>%
    select(founder_eligibility, eligibility_reason, everything())
  
  return(expected_founders_context)
}
```

```{r echo=FALSE}
colors <- c(
  "invalid response" = "gray",
  "ineligible" = "#F8766D",
  "new recruiter" = "#CD9600",
  "eligible recruiter" = "#00BA38"
)

# breakdown of Phase 1 resposnes
p1_all %>%
  mutate(
    recruiter = case_when(
      # `Referral ID` == "" &
      #   (`Do you live in the United States or Canada?` != "Yes" |
      #   `Do you consent to filling out your information and being contacted by our research team?` != "I consent") &
      #   `First Name` != "" & `Last Name` != "" & (Email != "" | `Phone Number (no spaces or dashes):` != "") ~ "not eligible for study",
      `Referral ID` == "" &
        `Do you live in the United States or Canada?` == "Yes" &
        `Do you consent to filling out your information and being contacted by our research team?` == "I consent" &
        `First Name` != "" & `Last Name` != "" & (Email != "" | `Phone Number (no spaces or dashes):` != "") ~ "ineligible",
      as.integer(`Referral ID`) <= max_ref_id ~ "eligible recruiter",
      as.integer(`Referral ID`) > max_ref_id ~ "new recruiter",
      .default = "invalid response"
    )
  ) %>%
  count(recruiter) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = recruiter, y = n, fill = recruiter)) +
  geom_col() + 
  geom_text(
    aes(label = n),vjust = -0.2
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Phase 1 progress...",
    # subtitle = str_glue("Accurate as of {date(last_updated)} @ {hour(last_updated)}:{minute(last_updated)} EDT"),
    x = "status",
    y = "number of Phase 1 respondents",
    caption = last_updated_fmt
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  # scale_fill_manual(values = c("#00BA38", 
  #                              "#CD9600",
  #                              "gray", 
  #                              "#F8766D"))
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors)
```

```{r include=FALSE}
p1_all %>%
  mutate(
    status = case_when(
      `Referral ID` %in% join_distinct_clean$`Referral ID` ~ "active recruiter",
      `Referral ID` != "" ~ "eligible recruiter",
      `Complete?_2` == "Complete" |
        ((`First Name` != "" |
            `Last Name` != "") &
           (Email != "" |
              `Phone Number (no spaces or dashes):` != "")
        ) ~ "not eligible to recruit",
      .default = "incomplete response"
    )
  ) %>%
  count(`Where did you hear about this study from?`, status) %>%
  filter(`Where did you hear about this study from?` != "" & !is.na(`Where did you hear about this study from?`)) %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  group_by(`Where did you hear about this study from?`) %>%
  arrange(`Where did you hear about this study from?`, desc(status)) %>%
  mutate(cumul_n = cumsum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r echo=FALSE}
for (m in unique(p1_all %>% mutate(month = month(`Survey Timestamp`)) %>% pull(month))) {
  if (is.na(m)) {
    next
  }
  
  temp_df <- p1_all %>%
    filter(
      month(`Survey Timestamp`) == m,
      # !p1_id %in% p1_all_invalid$p1_id
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      `Where did you hear about this study from?` = case_when(
        p1_id %in% p1_all_invalid$p1_id ~ "invalid_resp",
        `Where did you hear about this study from?` == "" |
          is.na(`Where did you hear about this study from?`) ~ 
          "Email",
          # "Unspecified",
        .default = `Where did you hear about this study from?`
      )
    ) %>%
    group_by(`Where did you hear about this study from?`) %>%
    arrange(`Survey Timestamp`) %>%
    mutate(cumsum = row_number()) %>%
    ungroup() 
  
  print(
    
    temp_df %>%
      # select(`Record ID`, `Referral ID`, `Survey Timestamp`, `Where did you hear about this study from?`, cumsum) %>%
      ggplot(
        aes(x = `Survey Timestamp`, y = cumsum, col = `Where did you hear about this study from?`)
      ) +
      geom_line() +
      # geom_point() +
      geom_text(
        # aes(label = cumsum),
        label = temp_df %>%
          filter(`Where did you hear about this study from?` == "Email") %>%
          pull(cumsum) %>%
          max(),
        y = temp_df %>%
          filter(`Where did you hear about this study from?` == "Email") %>%
          pull(cumsum) %>%
          max(),
        x = ifelse(
          m != month(today()), 
          as_datetime(str_c("2023", m, days_in_month(m)[[1]], sep = "-")) + (60 * 60 * 24 * 2),
          temp_df %>% tail(1) %>% pull(`Survey Timestamp`) + (60 * 60 * 24)),
        col = "#F8766D"
      ) +
      coord_cartesian(
        xlim = c(mdy_hms(str_c(str_c(m, "1", "2023", sep = "-"), "00:00:00", sep = " ")), 
                 mdy_hms(str_c(str_c(m, days_in_month(m)[[1]], "2023", sep = "-"), "11:59:59", sep = " ")) + (60 * 60 * 24 * 5))
      ) +
      labs(
        title = "Cumulative Phase 1 responses across each platform",
        subtitle = str_glue("{month.name[m]} only"),
        caption = last_updated_fmt,
        x = "time",
        y = "sum of responses",
        col = "platform"
      ) +
      theme_bw()
  )
}
```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
p1_all %>%
  # if all race cols are unchecked, designate the race as "Prefer not to answer"
  mutate(
    `Race (choice=Prefer not to answer)` = case_when(
      `Race (choice=American Indian or Alaskan Native)` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=Asian {race_asian})` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=Black or African American)` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=Hawaiian or Pacific Islander)` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=White)` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=Other {otherrace})` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=Prefer not to answer)` == "Unchecked" ~ "Checked",
      .default = `Race (choice=Prefer not to answer)`
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    # "Race" not followed by " Asian"
    cols = colnames(.)[which(str_detect(colnames(.), "Race(?! Asian).*$"))],
    names_to = "race",
    names_pattern = "(?<=\\=)([\\w\\s]+)",
    values_to = "race_val"
  ) %>%
  filter(race_val == "Checked") %>%
  mutate(across(race, ~ str_squish(.x))) %>%
  select(p1_id:Sex, race, `other race`:`How many cousins can you enroll?_2`)
```

```{r include=FALSE}
# pivot the race 
p1_race <- p1_all %>%
  # for records with no `Race ...` col checked, mark them as "Prefer not to answer"
  mutate(
    `Race (choice=Prefer not to answer)` = case_when(
      `Race (choice=American Indian or Alaskan Native)` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=Asian {race_asian})` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=Black or African American)` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=Hawaiian or Pacific Islander)` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=White)` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=Other {otherrace})` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=Prefer not to answer)` == "Unchecked" ~ "Checked",
      .default = `Race (choice=Prefer not to answer)`
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    # "Race" not followed by " Asian"
    cols = colnames(.)[which(str_detect(colnames(.), "Race(?! Asian).*$"))],
    names_to = "race",
    names_pattern = "(?<=\\=)([\\w\\s]+)",
    values_to = "race_val"
  ) %>%
  filter(race_val == "Checked") %>%
  mutate(across(race, ~str_squish(.x))) %>%
  select(p1_id:Sex, race, `other race`:`How many cousins can you enroll?_2`)

# rename race designations
p1_race_clean <- p1_race %>%
  # convert race names
  mutate(
    race = case_when(
      race == "White" ~ "white",
      race == "Asian" ~ "asian",
      race == "Prefer not to answer" ~ NA_character_,
      race == "Other" ~ "other",
      race == "Black or African American" ~ "black",
      race == "Latinx" ~ "latinx",
      race == "Hawaiian or Pacific Islander" ~ "pacific_islander",
      race == "American Indian or Alaskan Native" ~ "native",
      .default = race
    )
  ) %>%
  # remove duplicate records (people with multiple races) -> creates race hierarchy that favors minority enrollment
  distinct(p1_id, .keep_all = T)
```

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
p1_treatment_count_barplot <- p1_all %>%
  # pivot current treatments
  pivot_longer(
    cols = str_subset(colnames(.), "treatments.+currently"),
    names_to = "current_treatment",
    # names_pattern = "(?<=\\=)([[:graph:][:space:]]+)",
    names_pattern = "(?<=\\=)([\\w\\s]+)",
    values_to = "current_treatment_val"
  ) %>%
  filter(current_treatment_val == "Checked") %>%
  mutate(
    current_treatment = case_when(
      current_treatment == "Over" ~ "Over the Counter",
      .default = current_treatment
    )
  ) %>%
  # pivot previous treatments
  pivot_longer(
    cols = str_subset(colnames(.), "treatments.+previous"),
    names_to = "prev_treatment",
    names_pattern = "(?<=\\=)([\\w\\s]+)",
    values_to = "prev_treatment_val"
  ) %>%
  filter(prev_treatment_val == "Checked") %>%
  mutate(
    prev_treatment = case_when(
      prev_treatment == "Over" ~ "Over the Counter",
      .default = prev_treatment
    )
  ) %>%
  # pivot both 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(current_treatment, prev_treatment),
    names_to = "treatment_era",
    names_pattern = "(\\w+)(?=\\_)",
    values_to = "treatment"
  ) %>%
  # select(p1_id, `Do you have vitiligo?`, current_treatment, current_treatment_val) %>%
  # group_by(current_treatment, prev_treatment) %>%
  group_by(treatment_era, treatment) %>%
  summarise(count = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = treatment, y = count, fill = treatment)) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_wrap(. ~ treatment_era) +
  coord_flip() +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = count),
    # position = position_stack(),
    hjust = -0.2,
    size = 3
  ) +
  # geom_label(
  #   aes(label = count)
  # ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of treatments among Phase 1 respondents",
    subtitle = "comparing current vs. previous",
    caption = last_updated_fmt,
    fill = "treatment",
    x = "treatment"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
p1_treatment_prop_barplot <- p1_all %>%
  # pivot current treatments
  pivot_longer(
    cols = str_subset(colnames(.), "treatments.+currently"),
    names_to = "current_treatment",
    # names_pattern = "(?<=\\=)([[:graph:][:space:]]+)",
    names_pattern = "(?<=\\=)([\\w\\s]+)",
    values_to = "current_treatment_val"
  ) %>%
  filter(current_treatment_val == "Checked") %>%
  mutate(
    current_treatment = case_when(
      current_treatment == "Over" ~ "Over the Counter",
      .default = current_treatment
    )
  ) %>%
  # pivot previous treatments
  pivot_longer(
    cols = str_subset(colnames(.), "treatments.+previous"),
    names_to = "prev_treatment",
    names_pattern = "(?<=\\=)([\\w\\s]+)",
    values_to = "prev_treatment_val"
  ) %>%
  filter(prev_treatment_val == "Checked") %>%
  mutate(
    prev_treatment = case_when(
      prev_treatment == "Over" ~ "Over the Counter",
      .default = prev_treatment
    )
  ) %>%
  # pivot both 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(current_treatment, prev_treatment),
    names_to = "treatment_era",
    names_pattern = "(\\w+)(?=\\_)",
    values_to = "treatment"
  ) %>%
  # select(p1_id, `Do you have vitiligo?`, current_treatment, current_treatment_val) %>%
  # group_by(current_treatment, prev_treatment) %>%
  group_by(treatment_era, treatment, `Has your treatment been helpful?`) %>%
  summarise(count = n()) %>%
  mutate(prop = count/sum(count)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = treatment, y = prop, fill = `Has your treatment been helpful?`)) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_wrap(. ~ treatment_era) +
  coord_flip() +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = prop %>% round(2)),
    position = position_fill(0.5),
    size = 3,
    # hjust = -0.2
  ) +
  # geom_label(
  #   aes(label = count)
  # ) +
  labs(
    title = "Proportion of treatment helpfulness among Phase 1 respondents",
    subtitle = "comparing current vs. previous",
    caption = last_updated_fmt,
    fill = "helpful?",
    x = "treatment"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#F8766D", "#00BA38")) +
  theme_bw()

p1_treatment_prop_barplot
```

```{r echo=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
  group_by(`Referral ID`) %>%
```

```{r}
  filter(
```

```{r}
      `Do you have vitiligo?` != "" &
      (Email != "" | `Phone Number (no spaces or dashes):` != "")
  ) %>%
  filter(
    `Would you be willing and able to recruit your family members for this study?` == "Yes" |
      `Do you have an affected family member and if so, would you be willing to recruit them for this study?` == "Yes" |
      if_any(
        .cols = str_subset(colnames(p1_all), "How many .+ can you enroll"),
        .fns = ~ .x > 0
      )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    `Are you comfortable collecting medical samples at home? For this study, we will ask you to collect samples of your skin, blood, and saliva using devices we will supply. Click the following links to read more about the devices that we use: Blood drawing device Skin tape Micro patches Saliva collection kit` == "Yes",
    `Do you believe that your family members would also be comfortable collecting medical samples at home?` == "Yes"
  )


# how many "promised" recruits do potential Canadian founders offer?
pot_can_founders %>%
  mutate(
    across(.cols = str_subset(colnames(pot_can_founders), "How many .+ can you enroll"),
           .fns = ~as.integer(.x))
  ) %>%
  summarize(
    tot_recruits = sum(c_across(str_subset(colnames(pot_can_founders), "How many .+ can you enroll")), na.rm = T),
    .by = `Record ID`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pot_fam_size = tot_recruits + 1
  )
```

```{r enroll_summary_us, echo=FALSE}
# summarize enrollment statuses for all US residents in our cohort
enroll_status_summary_us <- all_join_us_v2 %>%
  mutate(
    across(.cols = c(`Enrollment Status`, `Family Size`),
           .fns = ~ (.x %>%
                       coalesce(.x[1]))),
    .by = `Referral ID`
  ) %>%
  select(p1_id:`Referral ID`, `Enrollment Status`, `Enrollment Comments from Clinical Team`, `Family Size`) %>%
  # filter out Phase II responses to get the number of families
  filter(!is.na(p1_id)) %>%
  count(`Family Size`, `Enrollment Status`) %>%
  rename("num_of_fams" = "n") %>%
  arrange(desc(num_of_fams)) %>%
  mutate(
    `Family Size` = as.integer(`Family Size`),
    `Enrollment Status` = case_when(`Enrollment Status` == "" ~ "New -- need to decide",
                                    .default = `Enrollment Status`),
    num_participants = `Family Size` * num_of_fams
  )


# compute family + participant totals for Ready vs. Waitlist categories
num_enroll_us <- enroll_status_summary_us %>%
  filter(`Enrollment Status` == "Enroll") %>%
  summarize(
    total_fams = sum(num_of_fams, na.rm = T),
    total_ptx = sum(num_participants, na.rm = T)
  )

num_waitlist_us <- enroll_status_summary_us %>%
  filter(`Enrollment Status` == "Waitlist") %>%
  summarize(
    total_fams = sum(num_of_fams, na.rm = T),
    total_ptx = sum(num_participants, na.rm = T)
  )
```

```{r enroll_status_ALL, echo=FALSE}
    across(.cols = c(`Enrollment Status`, `Family Size`),
           .fns = ~ (.x %>% 
                       coalesce(.x[1]))),
    .by = `Referral ID`
  ) %>%
  select(p1_id:`Referral ID`, `Enrollment Status`, `Enrollment Comments from Clinical Team`, `Family Size`) %>%
  # filter out Phase II responses to get the number of families
  filter(!is.na(p1_id)) %>%
  count(`Family Size`, `Enrollment Status`) %>%
  rename("num_of_fams" = "n") %>%
  arrange(desc(num_of_fams)) %>%
  mutate(
    `Family Size` = as.integer(`Family Size`),
    `Enrollment Status` = case_when(`Enrollment Status` == "" ~ "New -- need to decide",
                                    .default = `Enrollment Status`),
    num_participants = `Family Size` * num_of_fams
  )


# init. calculations 
num_fams_waitlist <- enroll_status_summary %>%
  filter(`Enrollment Status` == "Waitlist") %>%
  pull(num_of_fams) %>%
  sum()

num_participants_waitlist <- enroll_status_summary %>%
  filter(`Enrollment Status` == "Waitlist") %>%
  pull(num_participants) %>%
  sum(na.rm = T)

num_fams_enroll <- enroll_status_summary %>%
  filter(`Enrollment Status` == "Enroll") %>%
  pull(num_of_fams) %>%
  sum()

num_participants_enroll <- enroll_status_summary %>%
  filter(`Enrollment Status` == "Enroll") %>%
  pull(num_participants) %>%
  sum(na.rm = T)


enroll_status_summary %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(`Family Size`), y = num_of_fams, fill = `Enrollment Status`)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = num_of_fams),
    position = position_stack(0.5),
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Number of families in our potential cohort (US + Canada)",
    subtitle = str_glue("Ready to Enroll: {num_fams_enroll} families with {num_participants_enroll} total participants\n
                        Waitllisted: {num_fams_waitlist} families with {num_participants_waitlist} total participants"),
    x = "Family Size",
    y = "number of families",
    caption = last_updated_fmt
  ) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#F8766D", "#00BA38", "#BA55D3", "#FFD700")) +
  theme_bw()
```

## Race

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# pivot the race 
p1_race <- p1_all %>%
  # for records with no `Race ...` col checked, mark them as "Prefer not to answer"
  mutate(
    `Race (choice=Prefer not to answer)` = case_when(
      `Race (choice=American Indian or Alaskan Native)` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=Asian {race_asian})` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=Black or African American)` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=Hawaiian or Pacific Islander)` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=White)` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=Other {otherrace})` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=Prefer not to answer)` == "Unchecked" ~ "Checked",
      .default = `Race (choice=Prefer not to answer)`
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    # "Race" not followed by " Asian"
    cols = colnames(.)[which(str_detect(colnames(.), "Race(?! Asian).*$"))],
    names_to = "race",
    names_pattern = "(?<=\\=)([\\w\\s]+)",
    values_to = "race_val"
  ) %>%
  filter(race_val == "Checked") %>%
  mutate(across(race, ~str_squish(.x))) %>%
  select(p1_id:Sex, race, `other race`:`How many cousins can you enroll?_2`)

# rename race designations
p1_race_clean <- p1_race %>%
  # convert race names
  mutate(
    race_p1 = case_when(
      race == "White" ~ "white",
      race == "Asian" ~ "asian",
      race == "Prefer not to answer" ~ NA_character_,
      race == "Other" ~ "other",
      race == "Black or African American" ~ "black",
      race == "Latinx" ~ "latinx",
      race == "Hawaiian or Pacific Islander" ~ "pacific_islander",
      race == "American Indian or Alaskan Native" ~ "native",
      .default = race
    )
  ) %>%
  # remove duplicate records (people with multiple races) -> creates race hierarchy that favors minority enrollment
  distinct(p1_id, .keep_all = T)
```



```{r include=FALSE}
p2_race <- join_distinct_clean %>%
  mutate(
    `Race (choice=Prefer not to answer)_p2` = case_when(
      `Race (choice=American Indian or Alaskan Native)_p2` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=Asian {race_asian})_p2` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=Black or African American)_p2` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=Hawaiian or Pacific Islander)_p2` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=White)_p2` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=Other {otherrace})_p2` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=Prefer not to answer)_p2` == "Unchecked" ~ "Checked",
      .default = `Race (choice=Prefer not to answer)_p2`
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = str_subset(colnames(.), "Race(?! Asian).*_p2$"),
    names_to = "race_p2",
    names_pattern = "(?<=\\=)([\\w\\s]+)",
    values_to = "race_p2_val"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    race_p2_val == "Checked"
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(race_p2, ~str_squish(.x))) %>%
  mutate(
    race_p2 = case_when(
      race_p2 == "White" ~ "white",
      race_p2 == "Asian" ~ "asian",
      race_p2 == "Prefer not to answer" ~ NA_character_,
      race_p2 == "Other" ~ "other",
      race_p2 == "Black or African American" ~ "black",
      race_p2 == "Latinx" ~ "latinx",
      race_p2 == "Hawaiian or Pacific Islander" ~ "pacific_islander",
      race_p2 == "American Indian or Alaskan Native" ~ "native",
      .default = race_p2
    )
  ) %>%
  # select(`Record ID_p2`, race_p2, race_p2_val) %>%
  distinct(`Record ID_p2`, .keep_all = T)
```

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
  summarize(num_referrals = n()) %>%
```

```{r}
all_join_platform_summary <- all_join %>%
```

## Race


```{r include=FALSE}
join_race <- join_distinct_clean %>%
  # indicate Race as "Prefer not to answer" if everything is unchecked
  mutate(
    `Race (choice=Prefer not to answer)_p2` = case_when(
      `Race (choice=American Indian or Alaskan Native)_p2` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=Asian {race_asian})_p2` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=Black or African American)_p2` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=Hawaiian or Pacific Islander)_p2` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=White)_p2` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=Other {otherrace})_p2` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=Prefer not to answer)_p2` == "Unchecked" ~ "Checked",
      .default = `Race (choice=Prefer not to answer)_p2`
    ),
    `Race (choice=Prefer not to answer)_p1` = case_when(
      `Race (choice=American Indian or Alaskan Native)_p1` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=Asian {race_asian})_p1` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=Black or African American)_p1` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=Hawaiian or Pacific Islander)_p1` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=White)_p1` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=Other {otherrace})_p1` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=Prefer not to answer)_p1` == "Unchecked" ~ "Checked",
      .default = `Race (choice=Prefer not to answer)_p1`
    )
  ) %>%
  # Phase 2 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = str_subset(colnames(.), "Race(?! Asian).*_p2$"),
    names_to = "race_p2",
    names_pattern = "(?<=\\=)([\\w\\s]+)",
    values_to = "race_p2_val"
  ) %>%
  # Phase 1
  pivot_longer(
    cols = str_subset(colnames(.), "Race(?! Asian).*_p1$"),
    names_to = "race_p1",
    names_pattern = "(?<=\\=)([\\w\\s]+)",
    values_to = "race_p1_val"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    race_p1_val == "Checked",
    race_p2_val == "Checked"
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(c(race_p1, race_p2), ~str_squish(.x))) %>%
  mutate(
    race_p1 = case_when(
      race_p1 == "White" ~ "white",
      race_p1 == "Asian" ~ "asian",
      race_p1 == "Prefer not to answer" ~ NA_character_,
      race_p1 == "Other" ~ "other",
      race_p1 == "Black or African American" ~ "black",
      race_p1 == "Latinx" ~ "latinx",
      race_p1 == "Hawaiian or Pacific Islander" ~ "pacific_islander",
      race_p1 == "American Indian or Alaskan Native" ~ "native",
      .default = race_p1
    ),
    race_p2 = case_when(
      race_p2 == "White" ~ "white",
      race_p2 == "Asian" ~ "asian",
      race_p2 == "Prefer not to answer" ~ NA_character_,
      race_p2 == "Other" ~ "other",
      race_p2 == "Black or African American" ~ "black",
      race_p2 == "Latinx" ~ "latinx",
      race_p2 == "Hawaiian or Pacific Islander" ~ "pacific_islander",
      race_p2 == "American Indian or Alaskan Native" ~ "native",
      .default = race_p2
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    `Record ID_p2`:Sex_p2, race_p2, `other race_p2`:`Complete?_p2`,
    p1_id:Sex_p1, race_p1, `other race_p1`:`Are you comfortable collecting medical samples at home? For this study, we will ask you to collect samples of your skin, blood, and saliva using devices we will supply. Click the following links to read more about the devices that we use: Blood drawing device Skin tape Micro patches Saliva collection kit_p1`
  )

# remove duplicate people with multiple races (tries to prioritize minority)
join_race_clean <- join_race %>%
  distinct(`Record ID_p2`, .keep_all = T)
```

```{r}
  mutate(role = case_when(str_detect(form, "^p1") ~ "founder",
                          str_detect(form, "phase2") ~ "recruit")) %>%
  select(p1_id:`Referral ID`, role)


p1_all %>%
  left_join(
    y = all_join_joinable_df %>% select(-c(p1_id, `Referral ID`)),
    by = c("Record ID", "form")
  ) %>%
  relocate(c(`VIGOR ID`, role), .after = `Referral ID`) %>%
  filter(`Survey Timestamp` >= ymd("2025-1-1")) %>%
  # annotate dormant founders
  mutate(role = case_when(!`Referral ID` %in% c("", NA) & is.na(role) ~ "dormant_founder",
                          !is.na(role) ~ role,
                          .default = "ineligible")) %>%
  # filter out responses that did not specify a platform
  filter(!`Where did you hear about this study from?` %in% c("", NA)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = `Survey Timestamp`, color = role)) + 
  geom_freqpoly() + 
  facet_wrap(
    . ~ `Where did you hear about this study from?`,
    scales = "free"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Recruitment efforts since start of 2025"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

## Per push

Evaluate the effectiveness of every weekly Phase 1 -> 2 transition 



```{r include=FALSE}
# read in every contact list from each weekly email blast

# init. file constants
base_dir <- "../data/contact_list/phase2_subj_selection/"
base_file <- "new_recruiters_"
curr_file_base <- str_subset(list.files(base_dir), base_file)
correct_file_base <- str_subset(list.files(base_dir), "correct")
old_dir <- str_c(base_dir, "old_data/")
old_files_base <- str_subset(list.files(old_dir), base_file)

# init. absolute path of old data
old_files <- str_c(old_dir, old_files_base)

# read each old contact sheet as a DF into a list 
old_data_list <- lapply(old_files, read_csv) %>%
  # add new column "date_sent" to each DF that extracts and stores the date from DF's name
  mapply(
    FUN = cbind,
    "date_sent" = mdy(str_extract(old_files_base, "\\d.+\\d(?=\\.)")),
    SIMPLIFY = F
  )

names(old_data_list) <- old_files_base

# combine old data
old_data <- bind_rows(old_data_list)


# read in current contact sheet
curr_data <- read_csv(str_c(base_dir, curr_file_base)) %>%
  # add new col "date_sent" to extract and store the date that the current file was created
  mutate("date_sent" = mdy(str_extract(curr_file_base, "\\d.+\\d(?=\\.)")))


# read in the "correcting" file which contains the correct Referral IDs for handful of records that were originally assigned incorrect Referral IDs
correct_data <- read_csv(str_c(base_dir, correct_file_base)) %>%
  # add new col "date_sent" to extract and store the date that the "correcting" file was created
  mutate("date_sent" = mdy(str_extract(correct_file_base, "\\d.+\\d(?=\\.)")))


# remove "incorrect" records from old data and replace with correct data -> these records were assigned incorrect Referral IDs
old_data_clean <- old_data %>%
  filter(!`Record ID` %in% old_data_list$new_recruiters_10_2_2023.csv$`Record ID`) %>%
  bind_rows(correct_data)


# combine all into 1 DF
all_contacted <- bind_rows(old_data_clean, curr_data) %>%
  arrange(`Referral ID`) %>%
  # remove duplicate records ("correct" records might repeat with existing records that were previously pushed)
  distinct(`Record ID`, form, `Referral ID`, .keep_all = T) %>%
  select(date_sent, everything())
```

<!-- * #268, Ann Meehan: duplicate recruiter  -->
<!-- * #483, Jarrett Brown: duplicate recruiter -->
<!-- * #674, Gina Elmore: deleted and re-entered as separate record -->
<!-- * #677, Keanna Elmorehidalgo: deleted and re-entered as separate record -->
<!-- * #679, Brina Cloherty: deleted and re-entered as separate record -->
<!-- * #786, Grace Baker: ineligible to recruit -->
<!-- * #1278, William Bucci: dropped out of study -->
<!-- * everyone else is a dormant recruiter -->

```{r include=FALSE}
# init. Record IDs for different categories
dup_recruiter_ids <- c(268, 483)
reentered_ids <- c(674, 677, 679)
ineligible_id <- c(786)
dropped_out_id <- c(1278)
dormant_ids <- c(255, 374)

# add recruiter status
transitioned_recruiters <- all_contacted %>%
  mutate(
    # active = recruiter has referred 1+ person
    recruit_status = case_when(`Referral ID` %in% join_distinct_clean$`Referral ID` ~ "active",
                               # dormant = no referrals
                               `Referral ID` %in% (p1_no_refs %>% 
                                                     filter(!`Referral ID` %in% p1_dups_solo$`Referral ID`) %>%
                                                     pull(`Referral ID`)) |
                                 `Record ID` %in% dormant_ids ~ "dormant",
                               # self = they've only referred themself
                               `Referral ID` %in% p1_dups_solo$`Referral ID` ~ "self",
                               `Record ID` %in% dup_recruiter_ids ~ "duplicate_recruiter",
                               `Record ID` %in% reentered_ids ~ "reentered_under_new_id",
                               `Record ID` %in% ineligible_id ~ "ineligible_to_recruit",
                               `Record ID` %in% dropped_out_id ~ "dropped_out")
  )


transition_stats <- transitioned_recruiters %>%
  # only retain recruiters who are active, dormant, or self-recruiters
  filter(recruit_status %in% c("active", "dormant", "self")) %>%
  group_by(date_sent, recruit_status) %>%
  summarize(num = n()) %>%
  mutate(
    tot = sum(num),
    prop = num / tot
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# init. summary DF of active recruiter stats per weekly blast sent
transitioned_summary <- transitioned_recruiters %>%
  filter(recruit_status %in% c("active", "dormant", "self")) %>%
  # compute summary statistics for each email blast that was sent (aka, group by `date_sent`)
  summarize(
    total_recruiters_contacted = n(),                                                   # total num of recruiters per blast
    active_recruiters_contacted = sum(recruit_status == "active"),                      # num of all active recruiters per blast (referred at least 1 fam)
    `%active` = round(active_recruiters_contacted / total_recruiters_contacted, 3),     # prop of recruiters who are active (referred at least 1 fam)
    .by = date_sent
  ) %>%
  # select(date_sent, total_recruiters_contacted, active_recruiters_contacted, prop_active_recruiters, everything()) %>%
  distinct(date_sent, total_recruiters_contacted, active_recruiters_contacted, `%active`) %>%
  as_tibble()
```

```{r eval=FALSE}
# plot ALL cumulative Phase I + Phase II + Enrollment 


# function to handle DFs from different sources
prepare_cumul_df <- function(df, platform, pop) {
  ### INPUT PARAMS ###
  # ------------------
  # df: the dataframe to work on
  # platform:
  if (str_detect(str_to_lower(platform), "mdh")) {
    if (str_detect(str_to_lower(pop), "invitee")) {
      df <- df %>%
        arrange(CreatedDate) %>%
        mutate(
          date = as_date(CreatedDate),
          cumul_count = row_number(),
          pop = pop
        ) %>%
        select(cumul_count, date, pop)
    }
    else if (str_detect(str_to_lower(pop), "enrollee")) {
      df <- df %>%
        arrange(EnrollmentDate) %>%
        mutate(
          date = as_date(EnrollmentDate),
          cumul_count = row_number(),
          pop = pop
        ) %>%
        select(cumul_count, date, pop)
    }
  }
  
  else {
    df <- df %>%
      arrange(`Survey Timestamp`) %>%
      mutate(
        date = as_date(`Survey Timestamp`),
        cumul_count = row_number(),
        pop = pop
      ) %>%
      select(cumul_count, date, pop)
  }
  
  return(df)
}


# ALL responses from Phase I/II and MDH
p1_cumul_all <- prepare_cumul_df(p1_all, "RedCap", "phase1")
p2_cumul_all <- prepare_cumul_df(p2_clean, "RedCap", "phase2")
mdh_cumul_all <- prepare_cumul_df(full_cohort_imp, "MDH", "mdh invitee")
mdh_cumul_enroll <- prepare_cumul_df(full_cohort_imp %>% filter(!is.na(EnrollmentDate)), "MDH", "mdh enrollee")

cumul_all_bind <- bind_rows(p1_cumul_all, p2_cumul_all, mdh_cumul_all, mdh_cumul_enroll)

cumul_all_bind %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = cumul_count, color = pop)) +
  geom_line() +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Cumulative efforts of VIGOR recruitment + enrollment over time",
    y = "cumulative number of respondents",
    color = "population"
  )
```

## Race


```{r}
all_join_race <- all_join %>% 
  # indicate Race as "Prefer not to answer" if everything is unchecked
  mutate(
    `Race (choice=Prefer not to answer)` = case_when(
      `Race (choice=American Indian or Alaskan Native)` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=Asian {race_asian})` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=Black or African American)` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=Hawaiian or Pacific Islander)` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=White)` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=Other {otherrace})` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=Prefer not to answer)` == "Unchecked" ~ "Checked",
      .default = `Race (choice=Prefer not to answer)`
    )
  ) %>%
  # pivot race values (non-asian races)
  pivot_longer(
    cols = str_subset(colnames(.), "Race(?! Asian)"),
    names_to = "race",
    names_pattern = "(?<=\\=)([\\w\\s]+)",
    values_to = "race_val"
  ) %>%
  filter(race_val == "Checked") %>%
  mutate(race = str_squish(race)) %>%
  # remove duplicate records with multiple races -> naturally removes "white" first
  distinct(`Record ID`, form, .keep_all = T)
```

```{r eval=FALSE}
### EXTRACT NAMES OF EXCLUDED RECRUITERS TO SEARCH ###

get_names_to_filter <- function(excluded_recruiters_df, name_field) {
  # extract each word from First Name field
  excl_names_df <- str_extract_all(
    string = excluded_recruiters_df %>% pull(name_field),
    pattern = "\\w+",
    simplify = T
  ) %>%
    as_tibble()
  
  # return(excl_first_names_df)
  
  # merge multiple columns together if more than 1 column exists
  if (ncol(excl_names_df) > 1) {
    excl_names_df <- excl_names_df %>%
      mutate(
        # convert all empty strings to NA
        across(.cols = all_of(colnames(.)),
               .fns = ~na_if(.x, ""))
      ) %>%
      unite(
        colnames(.),      # columns to unite
        col = "name",     # name of new 'united' col
        sep = "|"         # separator
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        # replace any unwanted "NA" values
        name = case_when(
          str_detect(name, "\\|NA$") ~ str_replace(name, "\\|NA$", ""),
          .default = name
        )
      )
  }

  # init. pattern of first names to search for
  excl_names_pat <- excl_names_df %>%
    pull(1) %>%
    str_flatten(collapse = "|") %>%
    str_squish()


  return(excl_names_pat)
}

# init. patterns for First Name + Last Name
excl_fn_pat <- get_names_to_filter(expected_new_recruiters_excl, "First Name")
excl_ln_pat <- get_names_to_filter(expected_new_recruiters_excl, "Last Name")


# filter for Phase 1 records with names matching to excluded recruiters
p1_all_excluded_recruiters <- p1_all %>%

    str_detect(str_to_lower(`First Name`), str_to_lower(excl_fn_pat)) &
```

```{r eval=FALSE}
df_phase1 %>%
  filter(`Referral ID` == "") %>%
  # retain those live in US/Canada + gave consent
  filter(
    `Do you live in the United States or Canada?` == "Yes",
    `Do you consent to filling out your information and being contacted by our research team?` == "I consent"
  ) %>%
  # retain those who completed form, OR completed all relevant columns
  filter(
    (
      `Complete?_2` == "Complete" | (
        `First Name` != "" &
          `Last Name` != "" &
          `Do you have vitiligo?` != "" &
          # either address or city should be 
          (`Street Address` != "" | City != "") &
          # (State != "" | Province != "") &
          # State != "" &
          # TODO: Add province / Canada location stuff!!!
          (`Phone Number (no spaces or dashes):` != "" |
             Email != "")
      )
    ) & State != ""
  ) %>%
  # retain ppl who can recruit
  filter(
    # retain vitiligo patients who can recruit immediate family (Phase 1.1 + ipad)
    (
      `Would you be willing and able to recruit your siblings, children, or family members for this study?` == "Yes" |
        `How many children can you enroll?` > 0 |
        `How many siblings can you enroll?` > 0 |
        `How many family members can you enroll?` > 0
    ) |
      # OR, retain healthy patients with vitiligo family members (Phase 1.1 + ipad)
      (
        `Do you have an affected family member?` == "Yes" |
          `(choice=Child)` == "Checked" |
          `(choice=Parent)` == "Checked" |
          `(choice=Sibling)` == "Checked"
      ) |
      # OR, retain vitiligo patients who can recruit immediate family (Phase 1.2)
      (
        `Would you be willing and able to recruit your family members for this study?` == "Yes" |
          `How many children can you enroll?` > 0 |
          `How many siblings can you enroll?` > 0 |
          `How many parents can you enroll?` > 0 |
          `How many cousins can you enroll?` > 0 |
          `How many nieces and nephews can you enroll?` > 0 |
          `How many other people can you enroll?` > 0
      ) |
      # OR, retain healthy patients who can recruit vitiligo family members (Phase 1.2)
      (
        `Do you have an affected family member and if so, would you be willing to recruit them for this study?` == "Yes" |
          `How many children can you enroll?_2` > 0 |
          `How many siblings can you enroll?_2` > 0 |
          `How many parents can you enroll?_2` > 0 |
          `How many cousins can you enroll?_2` > 0 |
          `How many nieces and nephews can you enroll?_2` > 0 |
          `How many other people can you enroll?_2` > 0
      )
  ) %>%
  # AND, retain those who are comfortable/whose families are comfortable collecting medical samples at home
  filter(
```

### Multiple RedCap entries

Identifies all dormant founders who have submitted mulitple RedCap forms (either Phase I or II)

```{r}
# remove non-alphabetic characters and convert to lowercase
standardize_name <- function(name) {
  name %>%
    str_to_lower() %>%                # lowercase
    str_trim() %>%                    # remove leading and trailing whitespace
    str_replace_all("[^a-z]", "")     # remove all non-alphabetic characters
}

# function to prepare and standardize data in each tibble
prepare_data <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      First_Name_std = standardize_name(`First Name`),
      Last_Name_std = standardize_name(`Last Name`),
      Email_std = str_to_lower(Email),
      # only keep digits in phone number
      Phone_std = str_replace_all(`Phone Number (no spaces or dashes):`, "[^0-9]", ""),
      Birth_year = as.integer(`Birth year`)
    )
}

# prepare each DF
df_phase1_prep <- prepare_data(df_phase1 %>%
                                 anti_join(y = dormant_founders %>% mutate(`Referral ID` = as.character(`Referral ID`)),
                                           by = "Referral ID")
)
p2_clean_prep <- prepare_data(p2_clean)
dormant_founders_prep <- prepare_data(dormant_founders)

# function to identify potential duplicates across all 3 tibbles
find_duplicates <- function(df1, df2, df3) {
  bind_rows(
    df1 %>% mutate(source = "df_phase1"),
    df2 %>% mutate(source = "p2_clean"),
    df3 %>% mutate(source = "dormant_founders", `Referral ID` = as.character(`Referral ID`))
  ) %>%
    # factorize source so that dormant founders come first
    mutate(source = factor(source) %>% fct_relevel(c("dormant_founders", "df_phase1", "p2_clean"))) %>%
    # group by standardized first and last names
    group_by(First_Name_std, Last_Name_std) %>%
    # keep records of first + last name combo that appears 2 or more times across the 3 DFs
    filter(n() > 1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(First_Name_std != "", Last_Name_std != "") %>%
    arrange(source) %>%
    # add unique IDs for each record in DF
    mutate(id = row_number()) %>%
    select(id, source, everything()) %>% 
    distinct(First_Name_std, Last_Name_std, Email_std, Phone_std, Birth_year, City, .keep_all = T)
}

# find all potential duplicates
potential_duplicates <- find_duplicates(df_phase1_prep, p2_clean_prep, dormant_founders_prep)

# identify dormant founders with potential duplicates
dormant_founders_with_duplicates <- potential_duplicates %>%
  # retain dormant founders
  filter(source == "dormant_founders") %>%
  # remove records with duplicate First + Last name
  distinct(First_Name_std, Last_Name_std, .keep_all = T) %>%
  select(id, First_Name_std, Last_Name_std) %>%
  # rejoin with full dormant_founders data
  left_join(
    y = dormant_founders_prep,
    by = c("First_Name_std", "Last_Name_std")
  )

# function to verify duplicates using additional identifiers
verify_duplicates <- function(df) {
  # init. vectors
  
  df_fn <- df %>%
    # check for duplicate records when grouping by first name
    filter(
      n_distinct(Last_Name_std) > 1 | 
        n_distinct(Email_std) > 1 |
        n_distinct(Phone_std) > 1 |
        n_distinct(Birth_year) > 1,
      .by = First_Name_std
    )
  
  df_ln <- df %>%
    # check for duplicate records when grouping by last name
    filter(
      # check if there are more than 1 records with the same email/phone/birth year
      n_distinct(First_Name_std) > 1 |
        n_distinct(Email_std) > 1 |
        n_distinct(Phone_std) > 1 |
        n_distinct(Birth_year) > 1,
      .by = Last_Name_std
    )
  
  df_em <- df %>%
    # check for duplicate records when grouping by email
    filter(
      n_distinct(Last_Name_std) > 1 | 
        n_distinct(First_Name_std) > 1 |
        n_distinct(Phone_std) > 1 |
        n_distinct(Birth_year) > 1,
      .by = Email_std
    )
  
  df_ph <- df %>%
    # check for duplicate records when grouping by phone
    filter(
      n_distinct(Last_Name_std) > 1 | 
        n_distinct(First_Name_std) > 1 |
        n_distinct(Email_std) > 1 |
        n_distinct(Birth_year) > 1,
      .by = Phone_std
    )
  
  df_by <- df %>%
    # check for duplicate records when grouping by birth year
    filter(
      n_distinct(Last_Name_std) > 1 | 
        n_distinct(First_Name_std) > 1 |
        n_distinct(Email_std) > 1 |
        n_distinct(Phone_std) > 1,
      .by = Birth_year
    )
  
  bind_rows(df_fn, df_ln, df_em, df_ph, df_by) %>% distinct(id, .keep_all = T)
}

# verfity the potential duplicates
confirmed_duplicates <- verify_duplicates(potential_duplicates)

# create final list of dormant founders with confirmed multiple records in RC
final_duplicates <- dormant_founders_with_duplicates %>%
  semi_join(
    y = confirmed_duplicates,
    by = "id"
  ) %>%
  select(id:form, `Referral ID`, everything())

final_duplicates %>%
  select(`Record ID`, form, `Referral ID`, First_Name_std, Last_Name_std, Email_std)
```

```{r}
      .default = FALSE
    ),
    # Assign correct Record ID if pt is active in a different family
    `Record ID` = case_when(!is.na(referral_id_active) & str_detect(other_submissions, "phase2") ~ `Record ID_phase2`,
                            !is.na(referral_id_active) & str_detect(other_submissions, "phase1") ~ `Record ID_phase1`,
                            .default = `Record ID`),
    form = case_when(!is.na(referral_id_active) & str_detect(other_submissions, "phase2") ~ form_phase2,
                            !is.na(referral_id_active) & str_detect(other_submissions, "phase1") ~ form_phase1,
                            .default = form),
    # assign active referral ID for self-recruited founders or repeat Phase I respondents
    referral_id_active = case_when(is.na(referral_id_active) ~ `Referral ID`,
                                   .default = referral_id_active)
  ) %>%
  select(row, `Record ID`, form, active_family, everything())
  # select(`Record ID`, form, referral_id_active, active_family, First_Name_std, Last_Name_std, Email_std, Phone_std)




# init. constants for referral link 
u01_url <- "https://arcsapps.umassmed.edu/redcap/surveys/?s=E9FTLNDN3P"
referral_key <- "&referral_id="

# create contact list
dormant_founders_contact_list <- final_dups_context_4 %>%
  mutate(
    url = str_c(u01_url, referral_key, referral_id_active),
    form = case_match(form,
                      "p1_primary" ~ "U01 Primary Form (obsolete)",
                      "p1_ipad" ~ "U01 Collection form for Ipad ONLY (obsolete)",
                      "p1_second_round" ~ "VIGOR Phase 1 RedCap",
                      "phase2" ~ "VIGOR Phase 2 RedCap")
  ) %>%
  rename("Family ID" = "referral_id_active",
         "REDCap Form" = "form",
         "REDCap Record ID" = "Record ID")  %>%
  rename_with(.cols = str_subset(any_of(colnames(.)), "_std"),
              .fn = ~str_replace_all(.x, "_|_std", "")) %>% 
  # select(str_subset(colnames(.), "_std"))
  select(`REDCap Record ID`, `REDCap Form`, `Family ID`, active_family, First_Name_std, Last_Name_std, Email_std, Phone_std, url) %>%
  rename_with(.fn = ~str_replace_all(.x, "_std", ""),
              .cols = str_subset(colnames(.), "_std$"))
```

### All Dormant Founders 

Subsets a DF of all dormant founders' Phase I records. Already filtered out dormant founders who also appear in Phase II or elsewhere in Phase I


```{r}
# DF of all 'clean' dormant founders 
dormant_founders_all <- p1_all %>%
  # filter for all records with a Referral ID who did not recruit
  filter(!as.integer(`Referral ID`) %in% all_join$`Referral ID`) %>%
  mutate(
    # standardize string fields
    across(
      .cols = c(`First Name`, `Last Name`, Email, `Phone Number (no spaces or dashes):`),
      .fns = ~str_squish(str_to_lower(.x))
    ),
    url = str_c(u01_url, referral_key, `Referral ID`)
  )

# standardize string fields
all_join_standard_str <- all_join %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      .cols = c(`First Name`, `Last Name`, Email, `Phone Number (no spaces or dashes):`),
      .fns = ~str_squish(str_to_lower(.x))
    )
  )

# dormant founders in Phase II with same first name + last name
dormant_founders_in_p2_fn_ln <- dormant_founders_all %>%
  semi_join(
    y = all_join_standard_str,
    by = c("First Name", "Last Name")
  ) %>%
  select(p1_id:`Referral ID`, `First Name`, `Last Name`, `Birth year`, Email)

# search for dormant founders in Phase II using last name + birth year
dormant_founders_in_p2_ln_by <- dormant_founders_all %>%
  semi_join(
    y = all_join_standard_str,
    by = c("Last Name", "Birth year")
  ) %>%
  select(p1_id:`Referral ID`, `First Name`, `Last Name`, `Birth year`, Email)


# search for dormant founders in Phase II using first name + email
dormant_founders_in_p2_fn_email <- dormant_founders_all %>%
  semi_join(
    y = all_join_standard_str,
    by = c("First Name", "Email")
  ) %>%
  select(p1_id:`Referral ID`, `First Name`, `Last Name`, `Birth year`, Email)


# search for dormant founders in Phase II using birth year + email
dormant_founders_in_p2_by_email <- dormant_founders_all %>%
  semi_join(
    y = all_join_standard_str,
    by = c("Birth year", "Email")
  ) %>%
  select(p1_id:`Referral ID`, `First Name`, `Last Name`, `Birth year`, Email)


# merge all of these dormant founders in p2 and remove records that appeared from multiple joins
dormant_founders_in_p2_clean <- bind_rows(
  dormant_founders_in_p2_fn_ln,
  dormant_founders_in_p2_ln_by,
  dormant_founders_in_p2_fn_email,
  dormant_founders_in_p2_by_email,
  .id = "df"
) %>%
  distinct(p1_id, .keep_all = T)


# filter out dormant founders who are in Phase II because we don't want to contact them as founders if they're listed as recruits in P2
dormant_founders_p1_only <- dormant_founders_all %>%
  filter(!p1_id %in% dormant_founders_in_p2_clean$p1_id)
```


```{r}
# # phase I responses not recorded in `p1_all` 
# p1_all_excluded <- df_phase1_unclean_standard_str %>% 
#   filter(!p1_id %in% p1_all$p1_id)
# 
# # excluded records 
# dormant_founders_p1_only %>%
#   semi_join(
#     y = p1_all_excluded,
#     by = c("First Name", "Last Name")
#   )



# Dormant Founders in Phase I with multiple dormant records
bind_rows(
  dormant_founders_p1_only %>%
    filter(n() > 1, .by = c(`First Name`, `Last Name`)),
  
  dormant_founders_p1_only %>%
    filter(n() > 1, .by = c(`Last Name`, `Birth year`)),
  
  
  dormant_founders_p1_only %>%
    filter(n() > 1, .by = c(`First Name`, `Email`)),
  
  dormant_founders_p1_only %>%
    filter(n() > 1, .by = c(`Birth year`, `Email`))
) %>%
  arrange(`Email`, `Referral ID`) %>%
  select(p1_id, `Survey Timestamp`, `Record ID`:`Referral ID`, `First Name`, `Last Name`, `Birth year`, Email, `Phone Number (no spaces or dashes):`) %>%
  distinct(p1_id, .keep_all = T)
```

```{r}
  )

# look through entire Phase I DF for first + last name of dormant founder that repeats multiple time
# DF of all Phase I records where a dormant founder submitted more than 1 form (based on first name + last name)
p1_unclean_dormant_founders_dups_fn_ln <- df_phase1_unclean_standard_str %>%
  semi_join(

    by = c("First Name", "Last Name")
  ) %>%
  filter(n() > 1, .by = c(`First Name`, `Last Name`)) %>%

  # filter(n() == 1, .by = c(Email)) %>%

  select(p1_id:form, `Referral ID`, `First Name`, `Last Name`, `Birth year`, Email)


## can't join on last name + birth year because different people with same LN and BY can sign up 

# # look through entire Phase I DF for last name + birth year of dormant founder that repeats multiple time
# df_phase1_unclean_standard_str %>%
#   semi_join(
#     y = dormant_founders_p1_only,
#     by = c("First Name", "Last Name", "Birth year")
#   ) %>%

#   arrange(`Last Name`, `First Name`, p1_id) %>%
#   select(p1_id:form, `Referral ID`, `First Name`, `Last Name`, `Birth year`, Email)


# look through Phase I DF for email of dormant founder that repeats multiple time
# DF of all Phase I records where a dormant founder submitted more than 1 form (based on email)
p1_unclean_dormant_founders_dups_email <- df_phase1_unclean_standard_str %>%
  semi_join(
    y = dormant_founders_p1_only,
    by = c("Email")
  ) %>%
  filter(n() > 1, .by = c(Email)) %>%
  filter(!Email %in% c("", NA)) %>%
  arrange(`Last Name`, `First Name`, p1_id) %>%
  # filter(n() < 2, .by = c(`Birth year`, Email)) %>%
  select(p1_id:form, `Referral ID`, `First Name`, `Last Name`, `Birth year`, Email)


# merge these 2 DFs, filter for p1_ids in dormant founders, and isolate distinct records
# DF of every dormant founder in P1 who has submitted more than 1 P1 form
dormant_founders_p1_dups <- bind_rows(
  p1_unclean_dormant_founders_dups_fn_ln,
  p1_unclean_dormant_founders_dups_email,
  .id = "df"
) %>%
  distinct(p1_id, .keep_all = T) %>%
  filter(p1_id %in% dormant_founders_p1_only$p1_id) %>%
  left_join(
    y = dormant_founders_p1_only,
    by = "p1_id",
    suffix = c("", "_og")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(.cols = c("First Name", "Last Name"),
           .fns = ~str_to_title(.x))
  ) %>%
  select(any_of(colnames(p1_unclean_dormant_founders_dups_email)), url)
```
